title: Xerxes and Alexander visited the sites

tellings.quote: for instance these sites were visited by Xerxes Alexander the Great and many many other great people throughout history

plain: Ancient sites around Lake Van in eastern Turkey were visited by Xerxes, the Persian king, and Alexander the Great, along with many other famous figures through history. The researcher Matt LaCroix mentions this in passing without naming a source. He tells it to show that great rulers knew these places and thought them important long ago.
